sentences.text: MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 39125 of 2025  NARESH  Versus
THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH AND OTHERS

Appearance:
 Ms. Sharmila Sharma, Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Amit Raval, Govt. Advocate for the respondent/Stat  ORDER Learned counsel for the State submits that victim has been duly informed about filing of this application.

This first application has been filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.233/2025 registered at Police Station - Nagda, District Ujjain(M.P.) for offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 376(3), 376(D)(A), 506/34 of IPC,
Sections 5(l), 5(g)/6, 15 of the POCSO Act, 2012, Sections 66(E), 67B of Information and Technology(Amendment) Act, 2008 and Sections 120-B, 109 and 363 of IPC.
Applicant is in judicial custody since 06.06.2025.
Heard the arguments.
Perused the grounds for grant of bail stated in the application, case diary and the relevant material on record.

Learned counsel for the applicant, in addition to the grounds mentioned in the application, submits that the applicant is falsely implicated in the alleged offence merely for the reason that he is the owner of the R.D. Restaurant where NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:24727 2 MCRC-39125-2025 alleged offence was committed by other co-accused Arun and Sufiyan.

There is Naresh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 3 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119181874/
1 no allegation that the applicant was present at the time of the alleged offence or he has assisted the other accused in any manner.

sentences.text: The final report has been submitted on completion of investigation.
There is no likelihood of tampering with evidence by the applicant.
The final report is submitted on completion of investigation.
Jail incarceration is causing hardship to the applicant and dependent family.
Applicant is ready to cooperate in trial.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposes the application on the ground of gravity of alleged offence.
Learned counsel refers to 01 criminal antecedent of the applicant.

In reply, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the other matter at Crime No.145/2025 registered at P.S. Birla Gram, District Ujjain(M.P.) is pending for investigation and relates to identical prosecution.
Applicant has never been convicted.
According to the material available on case diary, Arun and Sufiyan committed penetrative sexual assault with minor victim at R.D. Restaurant in Nagda.
During investigation, it was revealed that the applicant is owner and Manager of the R.D. Restaurant, Nagda.
Therefore, applicant was apprehended on 06.06.2025.
The documents with regard to operation of R.D. Restaurant were recovered and seized at the instance of the applicant.
The victim did not allege presence and participation of the applicant in the alleged offence.
The veracity of prosecution and involvement of applicant will be determined after evidence in the trial.
As informed, the applicant is aged 43 years and runs a restaurant and has responsibility of dependent family.
Considering these aspects, there appears to be no possibility of fleeing from justice.

In absence of any substantial criminal past NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-IND:24727 3 MCRC-39125-2025 and previous conviction, considering the socio-economic status of the applicant, there appears to be no likelihood of tampering with evidence or influencing the witnesses by the applicant.
There appears to be no compelling reason to continue incarceration of the applicant.
However, the observations, herein-above, are recorded for present application only.

Considering the rival contentions and overall circumstances of the case, in the light of aforestated facts, but without commenting on the merits, this Court is inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Thus, the application is allowed.

Accordingly, it is directed that applicant-Naresh shall be released on bail in connection with Crime,
as mentioned in first paragraph of this order, upon furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand only) with one surety of the same amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court, for compliance with the following conditions : (For convenience of understanding by accused and surety, the conditions of bail are also reproduced in Hindi asunder):-
(1) Applicant shall remain present on every date of hearing as may be directed by the concerned court; (1)         
      (2) Applicant shall not commit or get involved in any offence of similar nature; (2)
